title: Métriques métier — Supermarket Demo
description: Parcours : Métier → Traffic / Latency / Errors → Stock → Saturation. Les volumes métier sont calculés à partir des deltas des compteurs Prometheus sur la période sélectionnée.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) | EVAL total_requested = end - start

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) | EVAL total_completed = end - start

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) | EVAL restock_gap = (requested_end - requested_start) - (completed_end - completed_start)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total) BY bucket

config.title: Métier — flux de réassort par période

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL requested = requested_end - requested_start, completed = completed_end - completed_start

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "rest" AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_rest = end - start

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "kafka" AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_kafka = end - start
FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.up IS NOT NULL | EVAL up_value = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.up) | STATS availability = AVG(up_value)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.process_cpu_usage IS NOT NULL | EVAL cpu = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.process_cpu_usage) | STATS cpu_average = AVG(cpu)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes IS NOT NULL AND metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes > 0 | EVAL used = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes), max_memory = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes) | STATS memory_ratio = AVG(used / max_memory)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_threads_live_threads IS NOT NULL | EVAL threads = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_threads_live_threads) | STATS live_threads = MAX(threads)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.process_cpu_usage IS NOT NULL | EVAL cpu = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.process_cpu_usage) | STATS cpu_average = AVG(cpu) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

config.title: Saturation — mémoire JVM dans le temps

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes IS NOT NULL AND metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes > 0 | EVAL used = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes), max_memory = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes) | STATS memory_ratio = AVG(used / max_memory) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_quantity IS NOT NULL | EVAL stock = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_quantity) | STATS stock = MAX(stock) BY product_id = attributes.product_id, product_name = attributes.product_name | SORT stock ASC

config.title: Traffic / Latency / Errors — statistiques HTTP par endpoint

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max IS NOT NULL | EVAL duration_ms = 1000 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max), error = CASE(attributes.outcome == "SERVER_ERROR", 1, 0) | STATS total_requests = COUNT(*), avg_ms = AVG(duration_ms), max_ms = MAX(duration_ms), total_errors = SUM(error) BY service = resource.attributes.server.address, method = attributes.method, endpoint = attributes.uri | EVAL error_rate = 100 * total_errors / total_requests | SORT avg_ms DESC
FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds IS NOT NULL | STATS total_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max IS NOT NULL | EVAL max_ms = 1000 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max) | STATS average_max_ms = AVG(max_ms)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds IS NOT NULL | EVAL error = CASE(attributes.outcome == "SERVER_ERROR", 1, 0) | STATS total = COUNT(*), total_errors = SUM(error) | EVAL error_rate = 100 * total_errors / total
